title: The Friend at Midnight
reflectionText: The man inside rises because of the other man's persistence. Jesus then says: ask, seek, knock. He does not end with a promise that every desired outcome will be granted; he ends with the Father giving the Holy Spirit to those who ask him. The comparison moves from a reluctant friend to a Father who gives good gifts. Where have you stopped asking, seeking, or knocking?
